subject.title: Group reply pipeline silently drops agent-generated payload between turn completion and Telegram sendMessage

question: Should OpenClaw recover substantive message_tool_only final replies that miss message(action=send), or preserve the current warn-only private-final behavior?
rationale: Current main makes the remaining source-proven no-outbound path visible but intentionally private, while the open recovery PRs change message-delivery behavior with privacy and compatibility tradeoffs.

options.title: Resolve recovery direction
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85714 as the canonical policy decision and land or reject a clean recovery PR before closing related reports.

options.title: Keep warn-only behavior
options.body: If maintainers decide message_tool_only final text must remain private without retry recovery, close or narrow the recovery PRs and document that this is expected behavior.

options.title: Split Telegram-specific repro
options.body: If recovery policy is separate, ask for a fresh live Telegram group repro after the identity and stranded-final slices are accounted for.

recommendation.title: Resolve recovery direction
recommendation.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85714 as the canonical policy decision and land or reject a clean recovery PR before closing related reports.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main blame for the warning-only behavior and Telegram reaction handling points to this recent area contributor, and the remaining choice is a maintainer policy decision.
